head: Uber Eats now delivers car parts in the US from AutoParts.com
dek: Since 19 November, Uber Eats in the US sells car parts from AutoParts.com, stocked from nearly 7,000 participating locations, for delivery right away or at a time you pick.
details: AutoParts.com is the first auto parts seller on Uber Eats; it pulls stock from distributors, independent suppliers and stores. For a limited time, orders of $60 or more before taxes and fees get 20% off, up to $20; the offer is for US orders in the app's Retail section and can't be combined with other offers. Uber One members keep $0 delivery fees on eligible orders. Orders can be tracked live.
where: US, Uber Eats app, Retail section
means: If your car needs a part for a repair or routine maintenance, you can have it brought to you instead of driving to a store.
todo: In Uber Eats, search for AutoParts.com, pick the nearest location, add the parts and choose delivery now or at a set time. The launch offer has no end date given, so check the app before you order.
thumb_words: UBER EATS NOW DELIVERS CAR PARTS
